content.user_title: Write Clear Documentation and Natural Fiction
content.value_statement: Unclear structure and repetitive phrasing make useful writing difficult to follow. This skill guides revisions around reader needs, explicit reasons, meaningful punctuation, and varied pacing.
actual_capabilities: Organize explanatory documents around reader decisions, consistent headings, and one judgment per sentence.
Explain purposes and reasons before implementation details, while identifying unsupported assumptions.
Revise Japanese punctuation and sentence structure to clarify meaning rather than imitate spoken pauses.
Improve prose pacing through sentence variation, concrete detail, and questions resolved later in the text.
Draft focused README documents and human-verifiable AI context files using separate procedures.
Revise fiction around perception, causal experience, and distinct character biases.
limitations: The guidance is written in Japanese, and some punctuation and heading rules are language-specific.
The skill supplies writing instructions, not an executable editor, publishing service, or automated validator.
Some guidance depends on external skills that are not bundled with these files.
Factual accuracy and inferred product requirements still require source evidence and human confirmation.

use_cases.title: Clarify Project Documentation
use_cases.description: Revise a README so readers can identify the project purpose, prerequisites, and shortest path to a working result.

use_cases.title: Structure AI Context
use_cases.description: Write AI context documents with explicit goals and summarized references that humans can check against their own expectations.

use_cases.title: Preserve Character Identity
use_cases.description: Improve a fictional scene by connecting perception to decisions while preserving each character's distinctive knowledge, priorities, and avoided choices.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a Paragraph
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this paragraph for clarity without changing its meaning: [paragraph]. Explain the three most important changes.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure a README
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this README for prospective users: [draft]. State the project purpose, prerequisites, and minimal usage path. Mark missing facts instead of inventing them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: focus project documentation on adoption and first use.

prompt_templates.title: Review AI Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AI context document: [draft]. Clarify its purpose, expected state, and reference summaries. Separate assumptions from confirmed requirements. Preserve human reviewability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: align AI instructions with team expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Revise Fiction Without Flattening Characters
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this scene: [scene]. Preserve each character's knowledge and biases. Deepen perception, interpretation, and resulting choices without adding unrelated events. Explain pacing changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: improve narrative causality and character distinction.

output_examples.input: Improve this explanation: We enabled server rendering. It helps SEO.
output_examples.output: To help shoppers find product pages through search, crawlers need product information in the initial response. Server rendering provides that information.

output_examples.input: Revise this fictional moment: Mina saw the unopened letter. She was worried. She left.
output_examples.output: The letter still lay unopened beside Mina's cup. She turned it face down before her brother entered. Then she left without her coat.

output_examples.input: Outline a README for a tool that turns meeting notes into task lists. Installation details are not yet confirmed.
output: Purpose: Turn meeting notes into task lists for teams tracking follow-up work.
Prerequisites: Confirm the required runtime and accounts before publishing.
Getting Started: Add verified installation steps and one minimal example.
Verification: Show how users can confirm that their task list was created.

best_practices: Specify the intended reader, document type, and decision the text should support before requesting a revision.
Provide verified facts and distinguish requirements from assumptions so explanations do not invent reasons.
Review revisions for preserved meaning, necessary context, and character identity rather than judging sentence length alone.
anti_patterns: Apply explanatory documentation rules mechanically to fiction.
Delete essential context or split causal relationships only to make sentences shorter.
Duplicate changing implementation details or present inferred motivations as confirmed facts.

faq.question: What kinds of writing does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers documentation, comments, commit messages, pull request descriptions, articles, and fiction, with dedicated procedures for README and AI context files.

faq.question: Is the guidance specific to Japanese?
faq.answer: The source guidance is Japanese. Many structural principles are broader, but punctuation and heading conventions need adaptation for other languages.

faq.question: Can it create a complete README?
faq.answer: It guides README drafting around purpose, prerequisites, and minimal usage. You must provide accurate project details and verify any commands.

faq.question: How does it handle AI context documents?
faq.answer: It puts purpose and expected outcomes first, adds reference summaries, and keeps instructions understandable to humans who review AI behavior.

faq.question: Does it include scripts or require an API key?
faq.answer: The reviewed package contains Markdown guidance only. No bundled scripts or API key requirements were found.

faq.question: Are all referenced skills included?
faq.answer: No. It references humanity-and-humanness, Japanese wording guidance, and skill-authoring separately. Their contents are outside this package and this audit.
